newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE March white sugar closes above resistance.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE March white sugar closes above resistance.

text.p: White sugar futures pushed through initial sell-stops above the $304 resistacne on the March contract by the close on Tuesday, traders said.
But volume was fairly light and included commission house crosses with March trading 1,034 lots and May the second highest total with 120 lots.
"There's nothing really outrageous and the volume is quite light," said one trader.
The March closed at $305.40 a gain of $4.00 on the day, while May was up $3.30 at $304.20 and other traded positions were also firmer.
Technically, March has passed its 40-day moving average at $304.00, which acted as a nearby resistance when it stood at $304.50 in Friday's session.

Physical brokers said the results of Iraq's tender to buy sugar under the U.N. oil-for-food deal would be slow to emerge as the financing arrangements would demand scrutiny from various parties and the tender restrictions were numerous.
Paris futures also gained ground although only the two nearbys were traded. March was up $2.90 at $305.00 and May up $2.00 at $304.00.
